title: record-commands.ts (304 LOC, budget 300) has no cohesive extraction target: capture/ is at its 30-file dirsize budget and its only subfolder capture/browser/ holds browser-child and browser-profile concerns
evidence: capture/ holds 30 files + browser/; node scripts/lint-dirsize.mjs OK at 110 dirs. Extractable groups (arg helpers lines 24-51; processRecordingArtifacts+validateIndexProof lines 207-239, ~35 LOC) are not browser concerns. Placing them in browser/ would be arbitrary; a new top-level file in capture/ would breach dirsize.
fix_direction: Approver decision: create a new capture subfolder (e.g. capture/finalize/ for processRecordingArtifacts + validateIndexProof, re-exported from record-commands.ts) or raise nothing. No budget change by maker.
